company_name: US Airways Group, Inc. (formerly America West Airlines)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel consumption not stated explicitly in gallons; AWA collars cover ~29% of combined US Airways Group 2007 fuel requirements. Net loss from hedging = $79M in 2006.

instrument_type_details.notes: AWA's costless collar agreements on heating oil cover ~29% of combined US Airways Group 2007 fuel requirements. Net fair value swung from $4.0M asset (Dec 31, 2005) to -$66M liability (Dec 31, 2006) as fuel prices fell, making below-market collars liabilities. Net loss from hedging activities in 2006 = $79M. US Airways (East) still had no fuel hedges.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption (gallons in millions) [table]: 435 [2006], 449 [2005], 450 [2004]. Note: combined US Airways Group (AWA + US Airways East post-merger).

warnings: Filed under CIK 706270 as US Airways Group (post America West merger). Ticker changed from AWA to LCC.
Net fair value swung from $4.0M asset (Dec 31, 2005) to -$66.0M liability (Dec 31, 2006) as fuel prices declined.
Final filing under this CIK for this company — US Airways Group subsequently filed under separate CIK.
